scenicChapters.title: Karakoram Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 66 km this is Karakoram Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Passu → Khunjerab Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 152 km. 4693 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

karakoram-highway-islamabad-khunjerab-pa.story: A one-way ride of 1130 km, Islamabad to the finish - roughly 15 h 40 in the saddle. The stops in between: Abbottabad, Besham, Chilas and Gilgit. The highest point is about 4,700 m. It crosses from Pakistan into China - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
